title: Blackout
profTagline: The city goes dark behind you, and out of that dark run the ones it already took. Run while the streetlights last — and make a runner from your own words, or your own photo.
topUpHint: The payment opens in Telegram; the coins arrive here on their own.
opened: The payment is open in Telegram
payFailed: The payment did not go through
guestCoins: The night keeps what you pick up — sign in to take it home
genSub: words or a photo → a 3D body
genPrompt: Describe the runner: style, clothes, mood…
camReason: The photo becomes the runner's look
camPrivacy: The frame goes to our server only to be described and is not kept
eBusy: The server is busy — try later
eRate: Too many requests — wait a bit
eFailed: Did not work — try another description or photo
installDesc: Add it to your home screen to launch it like a game.
installIosHint: In Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: Choose “Install app” in the browser menu.
